cohort: 4441 women delivering singleton and cephalic pregnancies at ≥36 weeks' gestation
finding: In women aged ≥40 years, labor epidural analgesia was not associated with an increased risk of emergency cesarean delivery compared to younger parturients.
mod_finding: The rate of emergency cesarean delivery was similar between women aged ≥40 years with LEA (9.5%), women aged ≥40 years without LEA (12.5%), and women <40 years with LEA (9.0%).
